test_label: DCF FCFF per-share vs independent oracle
formula_spec: EV=Σ CF_t/(1+WACC)^t + [CF_n(1+g)/(WACC−g)]/(1+WACC)^n; Equity=EV+cash−debt; PS=Equity/shares. Requires WACC>g, CF_n>0, shares>0.
error_cases: WACC<=g → ok=FALSE; shares<=0 → ok=FALSE; CF_n<0 → ok=FALSE

formula_spec: FCFE discounted at Ke; Equity = PV(FCFE)+PV(TV) with no +cash−debt.
error_cases: If FCFF bridge were wrongly applied, PS would include +999−50

formula_spec: FCFE_t = FCFF_t − IAT + g_t×BegDebt; BegDebt_{t+1}=BegDebt_t+NetBorrowing_t.
error_cases: Wrong debt roll → year-2 FCFE drift
deploy_impact: affects FCFE claim path on live v23.28+

test_label: DCF two-rate without yr_stage2 → NA (strict gate)
formula_spec: Two-stage path requires yr_stage1 + yr_stage2 with y1+y2 = n; remainder is not inferred.
independent_basis: Literal expectation NA when yr_stage2 omitted
error_cases: Missing stage-2 years stops two-stage EV (fail-soft)
deploy_impact: prevents silent remainder inference on live two-stage DCF
notes: Not a formula error; documented control from validate_stage_years

formula_spec: Years 1..y1 discount at r1; remaining at r2; Gordon TV uses r2−g.
deploy_impact: two-stage WACC mode on live app

formula_spec: Gordon requires discount rate > terminal g.
error_cases: WACC<=g would yield Inf/negative TV if ungated

formula_spec: V0 = D1/(Ke−g), D1=D0(1+g). Premise: Ke>g, D0>0.
independent_basis: oracle_ddm_gordon; UI path uses same algebra then round(p0,2)
deploy_impact: display rounds to 2dp (not a formula bug)
notes: UI round(p0,2) is presentation-only; helper returns full precision

formula_spec: V0 = E·g/Ke² + D/Ke (Brown & Abraham). Requires Ke>0; does not require Ke>g.
deploy_impact: SPM mode on live DDM tab

formula_spec: RI_t=(ROE_t−Ke)·BV_{t−1}; BV_t=BV_{t−1}+NI_t(1−payout); V0=B0+PV(RI)+PV[RI_n(1+g)/(Ke−g)].
error_cases: g>=Ke → error; invalid ROE path → error

test_label: RI linear ROE path vs oracle
formula_spec: ROE path = seq(roe_start, roe_terminal, length.out=n) for linear fade.
error_cases: Wrong fade → RI_t and TV scale errors

formula_spec: Implied Price = EPS × P/E. Unavailable if EPS≤0 or multiple≤0.
Fwd EPS = Trailing×(1+g/100); Implied = Fwd EPS × Fwd P/E. No price÷P/E back-solve.
error_cases: missing growth → NA fwd EPS; nonpositive trailing → NA

formula_spec: PEG = P/E ÷ growth%. Indicator only — no Implied Price.
notes: Out of price-oracle scope by design

formula_spec: EV/FCF: EV=metric×multiple; Equity=EV+cash−debt; Price=Equity/shares. Metric≤0 → unavailable.
EV/EBIT: EV=metric×multiple; Equity=EV+cash−debt; Price=Equity/shares. Metric≤0 → unavailable.
EV/EBITDA: EV=metric×multiple; Equity=EV+cash−debt; Price=Equity/shares. Metric≤0 → unavailable.
EV/Sales: EV=metric×multiple; Equity=EV+cash−debt; Price=Equity/shares. Metric≤0 → unavailable.
EV/ARR: EV=metric×multiple; Equity=EV+cash−debt; Price=Equity/shares. Metric≤0 → unavailable.
P/S: Equity=Revenue×P/S; Price=Equity/shares. Equity-side — no +cash−debt (unlike EV/Sales).
independent_basis: oracle_ps_price contrasted with oracle_ev_multiple_price same inputs
error_cases: If cash−debt wrongly applied, P/S would equal EV/Sales path
notes: P/S=150.00 vs EV/Sales=147.00 with cash=20 debt=50

formula_spec: EV=Σ(seg_rev×EV/Sales)+non_op; Equity=EV+cash−debt. Requires ≥2 positive segments.
